title: Senior Product Manager, Amazon - Sub Same Day
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Across Emerging Markets (10 countries across APAC, MENA and LATAM), Amazon has an opportunity to engage the next 500MM customers and build a $100B GMS profitable business in the next 3 years. The Sub Same Day team will build for this market to deliver shopping orders to our customers within the same day in a reliable manner. The program is rapidly growing, is highly cross\-functional in nature, intensive and requires a number of solutions to be built and scaled. We build extensible EM first solutions to drive SSD program’s product strategy and Improve Fulfillment Convenience for customers while reducing overall Cost to Serve.  

  

This role is responsible for driving a roadmap specifically for daily essentials, grocery, perishables served from Sub Same Day network at Amazon across IES. If you like to swim in unchartered territories then this is your opportunity to solve problems that no one has attempted to solve at our scale before. We work like an high\-octane startup driven by the passion to bring the Amazon experience to our customers across Emerging Marketplaces.
  

  

As a Senior Product Manager, you will be expected to come up with the PR/FAQ, vision, and business requirements for the some of the most impactful ideas contributing to customer experience WW. This will need you to understand pain points of various types of customers, prioritize business needs that could be different across countries, while coming up with well thought out product ideas that leverage some of the latest advancements in technology. You will launch products, and take them to market, demonstrating business impact across countries.  

  

The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about managing challenging, lengthy projects across multiple teams and locations and will run their initiatives like a business owner. They will be comfortable marshaling large amounts of data, and expert with new\-age technology domains to make recommendations and build business cases. We are looking for a tenured Product leader who shares Amazon's passion for the customer—someone who understands the importance of compelling features and functionalities in driving great experience. In addition, the candidate will also be able to influence without authority and earn trust of a wide range of cross\-functional, tech/non\-tech stakeholders.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Identify and prioritize the most impactful improvement opportunities across New and Existing customers specific to their Sub Same Day delivery experiences across all emerging markets
* Be the voice of the customer advocating for the ideal customer experience
* Build products creating meaningful long term positive impact to the business
* Align key/Senior stakeholders to a bold vision for SSD through PRFAQs and other strategy documents
* strive to build products improving the delivery experience and speed for our customers
* Benchmark competitive experiences across Emerging Countries (outside of North Americas, Japan, UK), and define and implement a roadmap of improvements in customer Experience.

------------------------

* 5\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Master's degree or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* MBA
* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

### **About the role**


This role splits roughly in half.


The first half is designing for franchise operations \- multi location brands, franchisee owners, and frontline staff each needing something different from the same product.


The second half is owning the layer between design and code. You'll own the design system \- the components, patterns, and code. You'll write frontend code yourself, and you'll define how design work becomes a shipped interface for everyone else on the team.


That second half is why this role exists. Our approach to product development is shifting. Instead of traditional mockup handoffs, product managers and designers directly build working prototypes directly in code, using AI workflows alongside our component library. Engineering builds on those prototypes rather than starting over. You own this system and ensure it's up to scale and quality.

### **What you'll do**

* Design and build UI in the same motion \- prototyping novel AI\-native interactions directly in code rather than in Figma\-then\-handoff, especially where no pattern library exists yet.
* Sit inside a pod (PM \+ eng lead \+ you) and take features from concept to shipped, rather than handing off a spec and waiting.
* Own the interaction and motion details \- loading/streaming states, transitions, micro\-interactions \- the polish that's nearly impossible to fully spec in a doc.
* Build and maintain shared UI components so the rest of the org can move fast without reinventing patterns feature by feature.
* Work directly in the production codebase.

### **What we're looking for**

* 4\+ years in product design, with depth in dense interfaces \- tables, forms, permissions, multi role flows.
* Real product/visual design judgment *and* the ability to ship real frontend code \- not a designer who dabbles in code or an engineer who cares about UI, but someone for whom design and implementation are the same skill.
* Hands\-on frontend engineering. A portfolio \+ GitHub showing shipped, interactive, polished products \- not just mockups or case studies.
* Design systems built and maintained at scale, in code. You should be able to direct AI tools to build and maintain prototypes that adhere to accessibility, component system, and other guardrails.
* Experience or strong interest in AI\-native interfaces: streaming output, agentic/human\-in\-the\-loop UX, confidence and uncertainty in UI.
* Bonus: has worked somewhere small enough that design and engineering weren't separate functions. AI used structurally in how features got shipped, from ideation through implementation and review \- not just for copy or asset generation.
